mcqs.question: With reference to India's seaweed sector, which pair correctly states the present production and the estimated potential production, respectively?
mcqs.explanation: India's seaweed production is 74,083 tonnes, while its potential is estimated at 9.7 million tonnes. The figure of ₹13.28 lakh a year relates to the annual generation potential from one hectare of Kappaphycus, not national production; 41% refers to seaweed extracts' share of the global biostimulant market.

mcqs.question: According to the December 2025 update on domestic savings and India's capital markets, which statement correctly describes corporate investment announcements in FY25?
options: They increased by 39% year-on-year, with about 70% coming from the private sector
They increased by 70% year-on-year, with about 39% coming from the private sector
They declined by 39% year-on-year, although about 70% came from the private sector
They increased by 39% year-on-year, with about 19% coming from the private sector
mcqs.explanation: Corporate investment announcements in FY25 rose by 39% year-on-year, and about 70% were from the private sector. The option reversing 39% and 70% confuses the growth rate with the private-sector share; 19% is not the stated private-sector share.
